intro_md: Items add a permanent percentage to your raw movement Speed, separate from Trails, Auras, and Treadmills. Core-shop choices have a Trophy price and a Robux price, so the real race starts before your feet even move.
description_md:
## Choosing an Item

Core-shop Items in the same rarity have the same listed Speed bonus and prices. Pick the look you like within a tier, then focus on moving up a rarity when you want a larger boost.

The Trophy route lets you save currency instead of spending Robux. Check both prices before buying, especially at Epic and Legendary rarity where the Trophy cost rises sharply.

## What the Speed bonus changes

An Item raises raw movement Speed by its listed percentage. It does not directly raise your Level, and it is not a Trail, Aura, or Treadmill multiplier wearing a candy hat.

Treat Items as their own upgrade path when planning progress. Compare their percentage bonuses with each other instead of mixing their values with the separate effects shown by other systems.
how_it_works_md: Speed bonus is the permanent percentage added to raw movement Speed. Trophy price and Robux price are the two purchase options for each core-shop Item.

description_json.Common Items: Common Items give a 3% Speed bonus and cost 3K Trophies or 49 Robux. They are the lowest-cost entry into the Item upgrade path.
description_json.Uncommon Items: Uncommon Items give a 5% Speed bonus and cost 25K Trophies or 89 Robux. The bonus rises a little, while the Trophy price takes a bigger step.
description_json.Rare Items: Rare Items give a 10% Speed bonus and cost 250K Trophies or 179 Robux. This tier doubles the bonus offered by Uncommon Items.
description_json.Epic Items: Epic Items give a 15% Speed bonus and cost 3.5M Trophies or 489 Robux. This is where the Trophy requirement jumps into the millions.
description_json.Legendary Items: Legendary Items give a 25% Speed bonus and cost 40M Trophies or 689 Robux. Their price sits well above the Epic tier, so this is a serious Trophy-saving target.

faq_json.q: What do Items do in +1 Speed Keyboard Escape?
faq_json.a: Items add a permanent percentage bonus to raw movement Speed. The exact bonus depends on the Item's rarity.

faq_json.q: Can I buy Items without Robux?
faq_json.a: Yes. Core-shop Items have a Trophy price as well as a Robux price, so you can use the Trophy purchase route instead.

faq_json.q: Do Items in the same rarity have different Speed bonuses?
faq_json.a: No. Items within the same rarity share the same listed Speed bonus and prices, so you can choose the design you prefer without losing stats inside that tier.

faq_json.q: How much Speed does a Legendary Item add?
faq_json.a: A Legendary Item adds 25% to raw movement Speed and costs 40M Trophies or 689 Robux.

faq_json.q: Are Items the same as Trails or Auras?
faq_json.a: No. Items raise raw movement Speed, while Trails, Auras, and Treadmills are separate upgrade systems with their own effects.
